; A response policy zone in the shape real feeds have (synthetic names).
$TTL 300
$ORIGIN rpz.example.net.
@        IN SOA ns.rpz.example.net. hostmaster.example.net. (
                2026112701 ; serial
                3600 600 86400 300 )
         IN NS  ns.rpz.example.net.

; QNAME triggers
malware.example.com          CNAME .
*.malware.example.com        CNAME .
nodata.example.com           CNAME *.
allowed.example.com          CNAME rpz-passthru.
dropped.example.com          CNAME rpz-drop.
portal.example.com           CNAME walled.example.net.
captive.example.com   300 IN A     192.0.2.80
captive.example.com   300 IN AAAA  2001:db8::80

; absolute owner, with the zone's name on the end
bad.example.org.rpz.example.net. CNAME .

; not applied: counted as unsupported
32.1.2.0.192.rpz-ip          CNAME .
ns.evil.example.rpz-nsdname  CNAME .
24.0.2.0.192.rpz-nsip        CNAME .
24.0.2.0.192.rpz-client-ip   CNAME rpz-passthru.
tcp.example.com              CNAME rpz-tcp-only.
info.example.com             TXT   "not a policy"

; broken
badaddr.example.com          A     not-an-address
